meanings: 【名詞】宗教；宗教信仰（a system of faith and worship, or belief in and worship of a god or gods）
【名詞】（個人や社会にとって非常に重要な）こと、事柄（something that is very important to someone and that they are very interested in or devoted to）
【名詞】信心深さ、敬虔さ；信仰心（the practice of religious faith and observance）
